text:
The new stadium plans at San Siro will be presented this afternoon, but the press conference did not get off to the best start, as Milan directors were absent, while Inter fans protested.
This is an historic day for the city of Milan, as after more than a decade of legal wrangling, the two clubs finally get to unveil their design for the new stadium.
There is an embargo on the images until this evening, but the press conference is being held at the Sforzesco Castle in the city centre.
San Siro stadium problems
As is fitting for a project so long mired in difficulties, it did not go entirely smoothly for all concerned.
Inter fans gathered outside with a banner to stage a protest against the ultimate demolition of the Stadio Giuseppe Meazza.
‘Lights at San Siro, you will never switch them off.’
Technically, the area of the city is called San Siro and there will be a stadium lit up there, as it will be built in what is effectively now the car park of the Stadio Meazza.
Sta per iniziare al Castello Sforzesco la presentazione alla stampa del nuovo San Siro davanti a circa 150 giornalisti.
Nessuno presente della dirigenza apicale del Milan a causa del contemporaneo svolgimento dell’assemblea in società.
I tifosi dell’Inter hanno contestato https://t.co/jH1tCwLrV6
— Tancredi Palmeri (@tancredipalmeri) October 29, 2026
Meanwhile, Milan directors were not present at the press conference, because it was scheduled at the same time as the shareholders’ meeting.
Instead, they sent Chief Revenue Officer Maikel Oettle and Chief Brand Officer Francesca Montini.
Inter were represented by President Beppe Marotta and figures from club owners Oaktree.
The original design presented by Milan and Inter a decade ago was no longer valid, so they started from scratch with a new project drawn up by architect Norman Foster.
It is reported to hold 71,500 seats and construction should require an overall investment of €2 billion.

לאחר יותר מעשור של דיונים משפטיים ומכשולים בירוקרטיים, אינטר ומילאן הציגו רשמית את התוכניות לעיצוב האצטדיון החדש שייבנה באזור סן סירו. האירוע התקיים בטחנת ספורצה במרכז מילאן, אך החל בצל מחאות של אוהדי אינטר שמחו נגד ההריסה המתוכננת של אצטדיון ג'וזפה מאצה המיתולוגי, וכן בהיעדרותם של בכירי הנהלת מילאן עקב התנגשות זמנים עם אסיפת בעלי מניות.

הפרויקט החדש, שתוכנן מחדש מאפס על ידי האדריכל נורמן פוסטר לאחר שהתוכנית המקורית הפסיקה רלוונטית, צפוי להכיל כ-71,500 מקומות ישיבה. עלות ההקמה הכוללת של המתקן החדש מוערכת בכ-2 מיליארד אירו, והוא צפוי להיבנות במתחם החניה הנוכחי של האצטדיון הקיים.
